findingsSummary: All deal breakers pass. Material residual risks are an admin-controlled vesting-substitution path (setVesting) with no output-bounds validation or timelock, an ADMIN role with zero execution delay at $75M+ TVL, and entirely off-chain backing of apxUSD with no on-chain proof-of-reserve. These are counterbalanced by strong smart-contract architecture (OZ AccessManager, OZ ERC4626 with built-in inflation protection), three top-tier audits, a 30-day withdrawal cooldown that structurally blocks flash-loan extraction, and a doxxed ex-Kraken team.
keyFindings: setVesting() accepts any IVesting with no output-bounds on vestedAmount() — admin can manipulate share price via 3/6 multisig with no timelock
ADMIN role has 0 execution delay — upgrades and config changes execute immediately at $75M+ TVL
apxUSD backing (off-chain MSTR preferred stock) has no on-chain proof-of-reserve mechanism
Both 3/6 and 4/6 Safes share an identical 6-signer set, limiting defense-in-depth
30-day UnlockToken cooldown structurally blocks flash-loan extraction; OZ 5.5.0 ERC4626 virtual shares makes inflation attack non-profitable
Three top-tier audits (Zellic, Quantstamp, Certora) with critical/high findings confirmed fixed; no public bug bounty

dealBreakerDetails.evidence: UUPS _authorizeUpgrade routes through AccessManager → 3/6 + 4/6 multisig. Deployer EOA (0x0442) revoked at block 24481052.
No single-EOA fund withdrawal. YieldDistributor.withdraw() restricted to multisig.
No governance token. Control is exclusively via multisig.
No governance mechanism exists.
No timelock deployed. No emergencyExecute() or fastTrack() found.
pause()/unpause() implemented on apxUSD, apyUSD, MinterV0, and CommitToken.
Managed single-asset vault; no external oracle consumed for share pricing.
No direct setPrice. Vesting substitution via setVesting() requires 3/6 multisig — not single-key. Flagged as HIGH finding.
Solidity 0.8.30 across all contracts. No known compiler-bug CVEs.
CEI on critical paths (CommitToken._withdraw deletes state before call). ReentrancyGuardTransient on YieldDistributor.
Supply cap ($100M) + MinterV0 rate limiting + 60s AccessManager delay + multisig.
No delegatecall to user-supplied addresses found.
_disableInitializers() called in ApxUSD constructor (line 78) and ApyUSD constructor (line 90).
All initialize() functions use the initializer modifier with zero-address guards on all params.
TVL ~$75.3M apxUSD supply. Three audits: Zellic (Jan 2026), Quantstamp (Feb 2026), Certora (Mar 2026).
7 of 7 core contracts verified on Sourcify with full metadata match.
Zellic critical finding addressed. Certora high finding confirmed fixed.
30-day UnlockToken cooldown blocks same-block extraction. Architecture flash-loan-resistant by design.
Yield from off-chain MSTR preferred-stock dividends (real yield), not circular emissions. APY < 100%.
depositForMinShares(), mintForMaxAssets(), withdrawForMaxShares(), redeemForMinAssets() all present.
Single chain (Ethereum mainnet). CCIP integration is interface-only.
Not a bridge protocol.
Not a bridge protocol.
